module: Glue Lua for C++ <-> Lua bindings: the __luaBind* functions are the __index / __newindex that the C++ engine places on the metatables of the exposed classes (getters, setters, inheritance). They are called back by the engine (names hard-coded on the C++ side), a modder normally does not need to call them. __finalizeLuaBindings is called by the engine after the classes are registered to optimize the metatables and configure the SimObjects.
usage: -- engine-internal usage; nothing to call in a mod
notes: DO NOT RENAME: the names __luaBindIndex, __luaBindIndexStatic, __luaBindNewindex, __luaBindNewindexStatic, __finalizeLuaBindings are hard-coded on the C++ side (code comment).

C++ class metatable convention: [1] = getters table, [2] = setters table, [3] = metatable of the parent class (super); for SimObjects: [4] getStaticDataFieldbyName, [5] getDynDataFieldbyName, [6] setStaticDataFieldbyName, [7] setDynDataFieldbyName. Results found in a parent class are copied into the child metatable (cache).
For static classes, a getter that is not a function (constant via addConstant()) is returned directly.

__finalizeLuaBindings only does the SimObject work if luaVMname ~= 'vlua' (outside the vehicle VM): detects the classes whose name starts with 'd' (byte 100) and that have isSubClassOf, flattens their hierarchy and installs the SimObject __index/__newindex (dynamic/static fields accessible as properties, obj.obj = itself).
Writing to a property that is not found or is read-only does not raise an error: the assignment is silently ignored (commented-out log). Reading an unknown property returns nil.
testBindings() is an internal unit test (TestNamespace.TestClassA/B): only exists if these test classes are registered.

__luaBindIndex.desc: __index of a C++ class instance: first looks for a metatable field, then a class getter, then walks up the parent class chain (caching). Returns nil if not found.

__luaBindIndexStatic.desc: __index of classes with static members: like __luaBindIndex but the getters are called without an instance, and a non-function constant is returned as is.

__luaBindNewindex.desc: __newindex of an instance: calls the setter of the class (or of a parent); silently ignores if there is no setter.

__luaBindNewindexStatic.desc: __newindex for static classes: calls the setter without an instance (setFunc(v)).

__finalizeLuaBindings.desc: Called by the engine once all the C++ classes are registered in the VM: installs the SimObject accessors (outside the vehicle VM) then optimizes the metatables without a parent (removes __newindex without setters, flattens the getters).

testBindings.desc: Unit test of the bindings (classes TestNamespace.TestClassA/B): assignments, calls, destruction and garbage collection; prints *** Unittest start *** / *** DONE ***.
